Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.es: Túnel completo: los peers envían todo su tráfico por el router. Solo llega a internet si tu regla de masquerade cubre las direcciones del túnel (una regla con out-interface-list=WAN y sin src-address lo hace).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.pt-BR: Túnel completo: os peers enviam todo o tráfego pelo roteador. Ele só chega à internet se a sua regra de masquerade cobrir os endereços do túnel (uma regra com out-interface-list=WAN e sem src-address cobre).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.fr: Tunnel complet : les pairs envoient tout leur trafic via le routeur. Il n'atteint internet que si votre règle masquerade couvre les adresses du tunnel (c'est le cas d'une règle avec out-interface-list=WAN et sans src-address).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.de: Full-Tunnel: Peers senden ihren gesamten Verkehr durch den Router. Er erreicht das Internet nur, wenn Ihre Masquerade-Regel die Tunneladressen abdeckt (eine Regel mit out-interface-list=WAN und ohne src-address tut das).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.id: Full tunnel: peer mengirim semua lalu lintasnya lewat router. Lalu lintas hanya sampai ke internet jika aturan masquerade Anda mencakup alamat tunnel (aturan dengan out-interface-list=WAN dan tanpa src-address mencakupnya).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.it: Full tunnel: i peer inviano tutto il loro traffico attraverso il router. Raggiunge Internet solo se la regola masquerade copre gli indirizzi del tunnel (lo fa una regola con out-interface-list=WAN e senza src-address).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.tr: Tam tünel: eşler tüm trafiğini yönlendirici üzerinden gönderir. İnternete yalnızca masquerade kuralınız tünel adreslerini kapsıyorsa ulaşır (out-interface-list=WAN olan ve src-address içermeyen bir kural kapsar).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.vi: Full tunnel: các peer gửi toàn bộ lưu lượng qua router. Lưu lượng chỉ ra được Internet nếu quy tắc masquerade của bạn bao gồm các địa chỉ tunnel (quy tắc có out-interface-list=WAN và không có src-address sẽ làm được).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.ru: Полный туннель: пиры отправляют весь свой трафик через маршрутизатор. В интернет он попадёт, только если ваше правило masquerade охватывает адреса туннеля (правило с out-interface-list=WAN и без src-address охватывает).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.pl: Pełny tunel: peery wysyłają cały ruch przez router. Dotrze on do internetu tylko wtedy, gdy reguła masquerade obejmuje adresy tunelu (spełnia to reguła z out-interface-list=WAN i bez src-address).
Full tunnel: peers send all their traffi.hi: फ़ुल टनल: पीयर अपना सारा ट्रैफ़िक राउटर से भेजते हैं। यह इंटरनेट तक तभी पहुँचता है जब आपका masquerade रूल टनल के पतों को कवर करे (out-interface-list=WAN वाला और बिना src-address का रूल करता है)।

Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.es: Los peers usan el router como DNS: necesita allow-remote-requests=yes en /ip dns, y el firewall debe aceptar DNS desde el túnel (agregar el túnel a la lista LAN lo hace).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.pt-BR: Os peers usam o roteador como DNS: ele precisa de allow-remote-requests=yes em /ip dns, e o firewall precisa aceitar DNS vindo do túnel (adicionar o túnel à lista LAN faz isso).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.fr: Les pairs utilisent le routeur comme DNS : il faut allow-remote-requests=yes dans /ip dns, et le firewall doit accepter le DNS venant du tunnel (ajouter le tunnel à la liste LAN suffit).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.de: Peers nutzen den Router als DNS: Dafür braucht er allow-remote-requests=yes in /ip dns, und die Firewall muss DNS aus dem Tunnel akzeptieren (den Tunnel zur LAN-Liste hinzuzufügen erledigt das).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.id: Peer memakai router sebagai DNS: perlu allow-remote-requests=yes di /ip dns, dan firewall harus menerima DNS dari tunnel (menambahkan tunnel ke list LAN melakukannya).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.it: I peer usano il router come DNS: serve allow-remote-requests=yes in /ip dns e il firewall deve accettare il DNS dal tunnel (aggiungere il tunnel alla lista LAN basta).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.tr: Eşler yönlendiriciyi DNS olarak kullanır: /ip dns içinde allow-remote-requests=yes gerekir ve güvenlik duvarı tünelden gelen DNS'i kabul etmelidir (tüneli LAN listesine eklemek bunu sağlar).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.vi: Các peer dùng router làm DNS: cần allow-remote-requests=yes trong /ip dns, và tường lửa phải chấp nhận DNS từ tunnel (thêm tunnel vào danh sách LAN là đủ).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.ru: Пиры используют маршрутизатор как DNS: для этого в /ip dns нужен allow-remote-requests=yes, а межсетевой экран должен принимать DNS из туннеля (это сделает добавление туннеля в список LAN).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.pl: Peery używają routera jako DNS: wymaga to allow-remote-requests=yes w /ip dns, a firewall musi przyjmować DNS z tunelu (dodanie tunelu do listy LAN to załatwia).
Peers use the router as DNS: it needs al.hi: पीयर राउटर को DNS की तरह इस्तेमाल करते हैं: इसके लिए /ip dns में allow-remote-requests=yes चाहिए, और फ़ायरवॉल को टनल से आने वाला DNS स्वीकार करना होगा (टनल को LAN लिस्ट में जोड़ने से यह हो जाता है)।

The firewall rule is added at the end of.es: La regla de firewall se agrega al final de la cadena input. Si tu cadena termina con una regla drop, mueve esta regla por encima de ella, o WireGuard no podrá conectarse.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.pt-BR: A regra de firewall é adicionada no fim da input chain. Se a sua chain termina com uma regra de drop, mova esta regra para cima dela, ou o WireGuard não consegue se conectar.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.fr: La règle de firewall est ajoutée à la fin de la chaîne input. Si votre chaîne se termine par une règle drop, placez cette règle au-dessus, sinon WireGuard ne pourra pas se connecter.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.de: Die Firewall-Regel wird am Ende der Input-Chain hinzugefügt. Endet Ihre Chain mit einer Drop-Regel, verschieben Sie diese Regel darüber, sonst kann sich WireGuard nicht verbinden.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.id: Aturan firewall ditambahkan di akhir input chain. Jika chain Anda berakhir dengan aturan drop, pindahkan aturan ini ke atasnya, atau WireGuard tidak bisa terhubung.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.it: La regola del firewall viene aggiunta alla fine della chain input. Se la tua chain termina con una regola drop, sposta questa regola sopra di essa, altrimenti WireGuard non riesce a connettersi.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.tr: Güvenlik duvarı kuralı input zincirinin sonuna eklenir. Zincirinizin sonunda bir drop kuralı varsa bu kuralı onun üstüne taşıyın, yoksa WireGuard bağlanamaz.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.vi: Quy tắc tường lửa được thêm vào cuối chuỗi input. Nếu chuỗi của bạn kết thúc bằng quy tắc drop, hãy chuyển quy tắc này lên trên nó, nếu không WireGuard không thể kết nối.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.ru: Правило межсетевого экрана добавляется в конец цепочки input. Если цепочка заканчивается правилом drop, поместите это правило выше него, иначе WireGuard не сможет подключиться.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.pl: Reguła firewalla jest dodawana na końcu łańcucha input. Jeśli łańcuch kończy się regułą drop, przenieś tę regułę nad nią, bo WireGuard nie będzie mógł się połączyć.
The firewall rule is added at the end of.hi: फ़ायरवॉल रूल input चेन के अंत में जोड़ा जाता है। अगर आपकी चेन drop रूल पर खत्म होती है, तो इस रूल को उसके ऊपर ले जाएँ, वरना WireGuard कनेक्ट नहीं हो पाएगा।

The file is downloading..fr: Le fichier est en cours de téléchargement.
